sub_parameters.name: Type
sub_parameters.description:
The condition type. The following type is supported:

- **ruleName**: rule name.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: IsDefaultRule
parameters.description: Specifies whether the rule is a system default rule.><notice>This parameter is deprecated.></notice>.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page in a paging query. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned per page.
> Do not leave PageSize empty.

parameters.name: RuleType
parameters.description:
The rule type. Valid values:
- 1: system rule
- 2: user rule.
